name: mister-handy
description: Mister Handy: the main session is HQ and orchestrates by default. A SessionStart hook marks HQ vs worker; HQ sends every substantive task out as a written brief to Orca worktrees, or to background subagents in git worktrees without Orca, then watches them through a STATUS file and acts when they finish, fail, ask or stall, without pulling transcripts back in.
